meta.title: feat: Add feature gating for halo2 imports in SDK and CLI crates
meta.body_summary: Feature gating for halo2 imports in SDK and CLI crates to make EVM proving/verification optional, improving compile times and reducing binary size for STARK-only users.

perf_labels.notes: Devin feature‑gated halo2 imports across SDK/CLI; maintainer guided through iterative fixes (default features, simplified gates, module‑level cfg) and merged after CI benchmarks passed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 368 changed lines across 17 files, this is a small-to-medium build‑system refactor by absolute volume. It fits a moderate incremental build optimization PR that merged after iterative review feedback and maintainer‑added improvements.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer jonathanpwang provided iterative feedback: keep evm‑verify as default in CLI, inline a single‑use import path, gate the entire static_verifier module and AggProvingKey struct instead of individual fields/methods, and simplify feature gates from any(feature = …) to feature = 'evm‑prove'. Devin applied each suggestion in follow‑up commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Making EVM‑related dependencies optional via feature gating should reduce compile times and binary size for STARK‑only users.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Feature gating across multiple Rust crates with conditional compilation requires understanding of Cargo features and cfg attributes. Devin handled the bulk implementation but required human guidance on granularity and best practices.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer inline comments requested specific design changes (e.g., gate entire module, keep default, simplify gates).
detection_detail.ci_auto: github‑actions bot posted benchmark results on multiple commits, showing mixed minor regressions (<2%) but no blocking performance impact.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body lists compilation verification commands; CI benchmarks provide performance comparison data but no direct compile‑time or binary‑size measurements for the feature‑off scenario.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Devin applied multiple fix commits addressing review feedback; maintainer added additional feature gating for e2e benchmarks, continuations, CI updates, and kitchen‑sink guest after approval.

core_change_summary.description: Added feature gating using cfg attributes and Cargo feature flags to make halo2/SNARK verifier dependencies optional in openvm‑sdk and openvm‑cli crates. Changes spanned Cargo.toml files (making snark‑verifier optional, adjusting default features), source files (adding #[cfg(feature = "evm‑prove")] around halo2‑related imports, types, functions), and module‑level gating for static_verifier. Maintainer later added further gating for continuations, benchmarks, and CI scripts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Maintainer added feature gating for e2e benchmarks, continuations crate, CI script updates, and kitchen‑sink guest fixes after the core feature gating was implemented by Devin. These are follow‑up adjustments to ensure full compilation coverage.
change_trajectory: Devin committed initial feature gating: Cargo.toml changes, cfg additions, default feature removal from CLI.
Maintainer inline reviews: keep evm‑verify default, inline import path, gate entire struct/module, remove redundant gate.
Devin applied fixes: reverted default removal, inlined path, gated static_verifier module and simplified feature gates to evm‑prove.
Maintainer added further feature gating for continuations, e2e benchmarks, CI fix, and kitchen‑sink guest.
CI benchmarks ran on each commit; final approval with lgtm.

review_signals.summary: Requested to keep evm‑verify as a default feature in CLI.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin reverted removal of evm‑verify from CLI default features.

review_signals.summary: Suggested to inline the single‑use halo2 function import path directly.
Advised to feature gate the entire AggProvingKey struct instead of just the field.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin gated the whole struct definition.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out redundant feature gate on keygen method after gating the struct.
Requested to gate the entire static_verifier module at module level instead of individual cfg.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin moved the gate to module declaration.

review_signals.summary: Simplify any(feature = 'evm‑prove', feature = 'evm‑verify') to just feature = 'evm‑prove' since evm‑verify enables evm‑prove.
Fix lint and run cargo fmt.

review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer added e2e benchmark feature gating and CI updates.

review_signals.summary: CI benchmark comparison tables posted for multiple commits, showing mixed minor regressions and improvements.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with initial feature gating.
Maintainer jonathanpwang provided inline review comments requesting specific design adjustments.
Devin responded with a series of fix commits addressing each comment.
Maintainer also pushed additional commits for related feature gating in continuations, benchmarks, CI, and kitchen‑sink guest.
CI benchmarks ran automatically on each push, showing minor fluctuations but no blocking regressions.
Final APPROVED review and merge after all feedback addressed.
